    g=[row[:] for row in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    vals=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in vals if c not in (bg,4)]
    for lc,mc in itertools.permutations(others,2):

        M=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==mc]
        if not L or not M: continue
        out=[row[:] for row in g]
        for orient in ('v','h'):
            if orient=='v':
                segs={}
                for i,j in L: segs.setdefault(j,[]).append(i)
                segs={c:sorted(rs) for c,rs in segs.items() if all(rs[k]+1==rs[k+1] for k in range(len(rs)-1))}
                if not (1<=len(segs)<=2): continue
                lines=[('v',c,rs[0],rs[-1]) for c,rs in sorted(segs.items())]
                def covers(l,i,j): return l[2]<=i<=l[3]
            else:
                segs={}
                for i,j in L: segs.setdefault(i,[]).append(j)
                segs={r:sorted(cs) for r,cs in segs.items() if all(cs[k]+1==cs[k+1] for k in range(len(cs)-1))}
                if not (1<=len(segs)<=2): continue
                lines=[('h',r,cs[0],cs[-1]) for r,cs in sorted(segs.items())]
                def covers(l,i,j): return l[2]<=j<=l[3]
            connected=[]; beamed=[]
            for m in M:
                src=[l for l in lines if covers(l,*m)]
                (connected if src else beamed).append((m,src[0] if src else None))
            if not connected and len(lines)!=1: continue
            if len(lines)==1 and not connected:
                # single line: markers beam away from line to the edge, edge cell becomes line color
                l=lines[0]
                if orient!='v': continue
                c0=l[1]
                for (i,j),_ in beamed:
                    out[i][j]=4
                    step=1 if j>c0 else -1
                    for jj in range(j+step, (w-1 if step>0 else 0)+step, step):
                        out[i][jj]=mc
                    out[i][w-1 if step>0 else 0]=lc
                # fill the line's own rows between line and far line
                for (i2,j2),_ in beamed:
                    edge=w-1 if j2>c0 else 0
                    lo,hi=sorted((c0,edge))
                    for jj in range(lo+1,hi+1):
                        out[i2][jj]=mc
                return out
            if len(connected)!=len(M): continue
            src=connected[0][1]; dst=[l for l in lines if l is not src][0]
            if len(lines)!=2: continue
            # extension cell: (dest axis start, source fixed coord) -> line color (vertical only)
            if orient=='v':
                out[dst[2]][src[1]]=lc
            for (i,j),s in connected:
                out[i][j]=4

                    lo,hi=sorted((j,s[1]))
                    for jj in range(lo+1,hi): out[i][jj]=mc
                    off=i-s[2]
                    newc=dst[2]+off
                    a,b=sorted((s[1],dst[1]))
                    rng=range(a,b) if s[1]<dst[1] else range(b+1,a+1)
                    for jj in rng: out[newc][jj]=mc
                else:

                    for ii in range(lo+1,hi): out[ii][j]=mc
                    off=j-s[2]
                    newc=dst[2]+off
                    a,b=sorted((s[1],dst[1]))
                    rng=range(a,b) if s[1]<dst[1] else range(b+1,a+1)
                    for ii in rng: out[ii][newc]=mc
            return out
    return None

def transform(g):

    vals=Counter(v for r_ in g for v in r_)
    bg=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in vals if c not in (bg,4)]
    for lcv,mcv in itertools.permutations(others,2):
        L_=[(ii,jj) for ii in range(hh) for jj in range(ww) if g[ii][jj]==lcv]
        M_=[(ii,jj) for ii in range(hh) for jj in range(ww) if g[ii][jj]==mcv]
        if not L_ or not M_: continue
        out=[row[:] for row in g]
        for orient in ('v','h'):
            if orient=='v':
                segs={}
                for ii,jj in L_: segs.setdefault(jj,[]).append(ii)
                segs={cc:sorted(rr) for cc,rr in segs.items() if len(rr)>=2 and all(rr[kk]+1==rr[kk+1] for kk in range(len(rr)-1))}
                if not (1<=len(segs)<=2): continue
                lines=[('v',cc,rr[0],rr[-1]) for cc,rr in sorted(segs.items())]
                def covers(ll,ii,jj): return ll[2]<=ii<=ll[3]
            else:
                segs={}
                for ii,jj in L_: segs.setdefault(ii,[]).append(jj)
                segs={rr:sorted(cc) for rr,cc in segs.items() if len(cc)>=2 and all(cc[kk]+1==cc[kk+1] for kk in range(len(cc)-1))}
                if not (1<=len(segs)<=2): continue
                lines=[('h',rr,cc[0],cc[-1]) for rr,cc in sorted(segs.items())]
                def covers(ll,ii,jj): return ll[2]<=jj<=ll[3]
            connected=[]; beamed=[]
            for m_ in M_:
                srcs=[ll for ll in lines if covers(ll,*m_)]
                (connected if srcs else beamed).append((m_,srcs[0] if srcs else None))
            if len(lines)==1 and not connected:
                ll=lines[0]
                if orient!='v': continue
                c0=ll[1]
                for (ii,jj),_ in beamed:
                    out[ii][jj]=4
                    step=1 if jj>c0 else -1
                    for j3 in range(jj+step, (ww-1 if step>0 else 0), step):
                        out[ii][j3]=mcv
                    out[ii][ww-1 if step>0 else 0]=lcv
                for (ii,jj),_ in beamed:
                    edge=ww-1 if jj>c0 else 0
                    lo_,hi_=sorted((c0,edge))
                    for j3 in range(lo_+1,hi_+1): out[ii][j3]=mcv
                return out
            if len(lines)!=2 or len(connected)!=len(M_): continue

            # length-equalizing extension of source line toward dest
            slen=srcl[3]-srcl[2]+1; dlen=dstl[3]-dstl[2]+1

            for (ii,jj),s_ in connected:
                out[ii][jj]=4
                if orient=='v':
                    lo_,hi_=sorted((jj,s_[1]))
                    for j3 in range(lo_+1,hi_): out[ii][j3]=mcv
                    off_=ii-s_[2]; newc_=dstl[2]+off_
                    aa,bb=sorted((s_[1],dstl[1]))
                    rng_=range(aa,bb) if s_[1]<dstl[1] else range(aa+1,bb+1)
